summary: Mistral Free mode lets you create API keys and use included monthly API usage within the limits shown on your account's Limits page. The Free plan also includes Mistral Studio access. Current official documentation does not publish a dollar allowance; check your Organization's included usage and limits rather than assuming a fixed credit amount. This remains an ongoing Free-mode listing, with curator verification pending.
claim_steps: Create or sign in to a Mistral account and open Mistral Studio.
Use Free mode and review Admin Panel > API > Limits for your Organization's included usage and API limits.
Create an API key and keep requests within the displayed limits; review Subscriptions before enabling pay-as-you-go usage.

social_proof.title: Usage and limits | Mistral Docs
social_proof.text: Your Mistral plan defines the included monthly usage and limits available to your Organization. Free mode lets you create API keys and use included monthly usage within the limits shown on the Limits page.

social_proof.title: Pricing | Mistral
social_proof.text: On the Free plan, you also get access to Mistral Studio.
